passwordPolicyCard.title: Password policy
passwordPolicyCard.maxAgeTip: 0 = no forced expiry. Once expired, the panel only allows changing the password until a new one is set.
passwordPolicyCard.sessionTTLTip: How long a login session stays valid before the user must log in again.

settingsCard.title: Brute-force protection
settingsCard.failThresholdTip: How many consecutive wrong attempts (within the window below) trigger a ban.
settingsCard.countWindowTip: How far back failed attempts are counted toward the ban threshold.
settingsCard.escalationFactorTip: How much longer each ban gets if the same key re-offends shortly after the previous ban (default 2 — 5 → 10 → 20 minutes, etc).
settingsCard.escalationResetTip: If there's no new violation for this long after a ban expires, the next ban starts back at the base duration.

ipRulesCard.title: IP lists
ipRulesCard.description: "Deny" rejects login attempts from that IP outright. "Allow" exempts an IP from brute-force checks entirely (no bans applied) -- e.g. for a trusted office network.
